verdict.rationale: Close's docs state that it publishes an OpenAPI spec at https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json. A probe confirmed that a live openapi.json with an "openapi" key is served at developer.close.com, and endpoint docs include schemas. Missing for 10: the documented api.close.com URL itself was not probed, and the spec's completeness or coverage of all endpoints is unverified.
